headline: Anthropic Targets Valuation up to $2 Trillion in Planned Public Offering
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic is preparing for an initial public offering targeting a valuation between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion, following its previous funding valuation of $965 billion.
why: Anthropic is a major developer of generative AI foundation models. A public listing of this magnitude represents a milestone for venture capital liquidity and market benchmarks for AI sector valuations.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: A multi-trillion-dollar IPO target sets high benchmark multiples for private and public AI developers.
